scope: All units read: text for sense and metre, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page.

items.issue: lakṣmaṇapūrvajam was rendered “elder brother's-junior to Lakṣmaṇa”.
rame (“I delight”) had no verb in the translation, which read as a string of locatives.
items.change: Now “Saying ‘the name of Rāma’, ‘Rāma’, I delight in Rāma, the delight of the mind”.

items.issue: Three letters look dropped in transcription; the word glosses already have the full forms. Verse 13: rāmanāmābhirakṣitam for rāmanāmnābhirakṣitam. Verse 25: naraḥ for narāḥ (plural, with te). Verse 26: daśarathanayaṃ for daśarathatanayaṃ (the line is a syllable short of the metre).
items.recommend: A: grammar or metre requires each.

items.issue: The last verse begins rāmanāmeti rāmeti; the form usually recited is śrī rāma rāma rāmeti.
options: B. Change to śrī rāma rāma rāmeti and adjust the translation.
items.recommend: A unless your recitation text has B.
